### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the Node.js type-definition and collection-interface updates. **No open issues** 🎉
1 file not reviewed
  • extensions/copilot/pnpm-lock.yaml: Generated file
What changed in this PR Aligns the Copilot extension’s Node.js type definitions with the rest of the repository and updates affected collection interfaces and test doubles. **Changes:** - Updates `@types/node` from 22.x to 24.x and refreshes lockfile references. - Adapts custom collections to `MapIterator` and `SetIterator`, including disposal methods on hand-built iterators. - Updates SQLite authorizer test doubles for the newer type definitions. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `extensions/​copilot/​src/​util/​vs/​base/​common/​observableInternal/​set.ts` | Uses `SetIterator` return types for observable sets. | | `extensions/​copilot/​src/​util/​vs/​base/​common/​observableInternal/​map.ts` | Uses `MapIterator` return types for observable maps. | | `extensions/​copilot/​src/​util/​vs/​base/​common/​map.ts` | Updates collection signatures and adds iterator disposal methods. | | `extensions/​copilot/​src/​util/​vs/​base/​common/​collections.ts` | Updates `SetWithKey` iterator return types. | | `extensions/​copilot/​src/​platform/​chronicle/​node/​test/​sessionStore.spec.ts` | Adapts missing and failing authorizer test doubles. | | `extensions/​copilot/​src/​extension/​typescriptContext/​serverPlugin/​src/​common/​utils.ts` | Updates the server plugin’s linked-map signatures and iterators. | | `extensions/​copilot/​src/​extension/​completions-core/​vscode-node/​lib/​src/​helpers/​cache.ts` | Updates LRU cache iterator return types. | | `extensions/​copilot/​pnpm-lock.yaml` | Resolves Node.js types to 24.13.2 and refreshes dependent entries. | | `extensions/​copilot/​package.json` | Sets the Node.js type dependency to `24.x`. |
Review effort: Balanced
